input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='.shockharness.toml'
s=open(p).read()
old='boundaries = []\n'
assert s.count(old)==1
new='''boundaries = [
  { path = "src/storage.js", language = "javascript", exception = "SyntaxError", reason = "Decoding text read from localStorage, which the program does not control; a parse failure becomes a typed UnreadableNotesError carrying the raw text" },
  { path = "src/load.js", language = "javascript", exception = "UnreadableNotesError", reason = "Startup boundary: unreadable stored notes are quarantined under another key and reported to the user once, as SPEC.md requires, instead of crashing the page" },
]
'''
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
EOF
shockharness check src
